verdict.rationale: Runpod has a dedicated security-and-compliance reference page. It states that Secure Cloud runs on vetted partners holding SOC 2, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS certifications, and that Pods and workers get containerized isolation in a multi-tenant environment. The Pods docs add that Secure Cloud runs in T3/T4 data centers, separate from the peer-to-peer Community Cloud. Missing for 10: evidence that Runpod itself (not just its datacenter partners) holds SOC 2, a way to obtain audit reports or a trust portal for verification, detailed data-handling policies (encryption, retention, access controls), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
